scope: Bounded exploratory reanalysis of newest paired A-E captures. No new raw capture, thesis modification or Overleaf update. These records were repeatedly viewed during development and are not an independent confirmatory test.
inputs: Reuse and hash-verify the exact selected raw-packet caches and ledgers from coherent_array_validation_20261106. Preserve old results. No coherent assembly or cross-state interpolation is used.
budget: 864 distinct raw packets per arm/run at every point. Twelve-antenna noncoherent arm: 24 complete switching cycles x 6 states x 6 packets. G2: 24 chronological batches x 36 G2 packets. R1 first 8 cycles/batches (288 packets) fit the reference and weights; last 16 are an untouched empty check. R2 first12 (432 packets) predict; last12 check. R3 uses the same full and split diagnostics. Whole-run results are descriptive only.
geometry: Confirmed physical antenna coordinates and six-state mapping, actual 30 HT40 tones. Fixed forward local angle grid -90:1:+90 deg. No human coordinates or human labels beyond run roles are read by prediction code. No empirical per-point phase flattening, radius fitting or truth-based sign choice.
representation: Same-frequency 3x3 uncentered spatial covariance, averaged over unit-total-power packets. Common per-packet phase and timing slope cancel within each frequency; no packet phase fitting is required for this representation. Hardware-relative phase does not cancel. Covariance difference is permitted; raw complex CSI subtraction is not performed.
primary: R1-reliability-weighted, shrinkage-whitened background-projected MUSIC (WBG-R1), an experimental adaptation defined here, not a claim of a published named method. All six states contribute nonzero weights. Compare against G2 with the same WBG kernel and also the unchanged G2 BG reference.

kernels.BG: Existing rank1 background-projected MUSIC. h=principal R1 vector, B=I-hhH, u=principal B R2 B eigenvector; cost sum aH(B-uuH)a / sum aHBa. Raw R1 dominance >=0.70; foreground eigenvalue exceeds both R1 4-cycle training blocks; >=half tones per band; projected manifold energy >=10% of unprojected.
kernels.POS: Existing positive rank1 covariance-difference MUSIC, no whitening. Fixed numerical positive/eigengap test. All sites use the same rule.
kernels.SIGNED: Existing signed covariance-difference MUSIC. Rank is number of |eigenvalues| above max R1 training-block spectral deviation; only ranks1/2 allowed, normalize noise residual by 3/(3-q). All sites use this fixed rule.
kernels.WBG: W=(0.9 R1 + 0.1 trace(R1)/3 I)^(-1/2). Transform both target/reference covariance and every steering vector by W. Project principal transformed R1 vector, then fit one foreground eigenvector in that projected space. Tone dominance is assessed on raw R1. Training floor, steering denominator and energy exclusion use the transformed coordinates consistently. Shrinkage 0.1 is fixed, not searched.

fusion: Original pooled numerator/denominator is the equal baseline. R1-weighted fusion instead takes a state-balanced weighted mean of each valid state's normalized MUSIC residual; normalize SIGNED by its residual rank as in the baseline. R1 weight q_s=geometric mean over 30 tones and 3 pairs of clipped squared same-packet circular coherences (floor 0.05), divided by 1+d_s, where d_s is median-tone max-four-block relative covariance deviation. Clip weight to [0.05,1], normalize across all six states. Fit only R1 first8 cycles; never select weights by R2/R3 angle or survey error. All six states need >=half valid tones, so a missing state blocks a complete twelve-antenna estimate rather than silently reducing the array.
peak_rule: Single global minimum on the full forward grid. Also export the three best separated local minima, including endpoint minima, with at least15deg separation. A competing minimum within3dB is flagged as unresolved, not replaced by a truth-near candidate.
checks: For R2 and separately the R3 empty control: first/last half within9deg; first and held half low/high-band peaks each within9deg of first-half peak; >=3 of4 quarter peaks within9deg; |peak|<87deg; >=3dB separated-alternative margin; projected residual power exceeds R1-held empty power. R2 additionally requires residual power exceeding R3 and no R3 full/low/high peak consistently within9deg. Report every failed check. R3 pre-paired-control acceptance is an internal false-candidate diagnostic, not a population false-alarm rate. Leave-one-G-state and R1-to-held/R3 phase checks are reported separately, not independent validators; C1/C2 share antennas.
comparison: All five points and all predefined arms remain in the report. Stable-gain criterion for the primary SIX_WBG_R1: all five numerical outputs; lower overall mean separation, no worse median or maximum, improvement at >=4/5 points, candidate coverage >= baseline and >0, and no increase in R3 false candidates, against both G2_WBG and G2_BG. This remains development evidence and cannot prove human AoA without calibration/path attribution. Missing outputs are not removed to improve MAE; report complete-set MAE as NA if any are missing, with available-output statistics separately.
freeze: Save/hash protocol, weights, predictions, spectra and code before a separate scoring script joins survey geometry. No post-scoring tuning or per-point method switch. If primary fails, describe why; predefined comparator outcomes are sensitivities, not substituted as a newly confirmed primary.
stop: Stop after this bounded set of methods and integrity checks. No additional tuning sweep after inspecting geometry. Physical human AoA/ToF/position release remains unverified without independent calibration and human-path evidence.
